title: Payments and Waivers on Estimate-Stage Charges — Repair Estimates & Appointments Receivables Rule
content:
**1. One charge at a time.** Every payment or waiver on a Repair Estimates & Appointments booking names exactly one estimate-stage charge and never exceeds that charge's outstanding amount — the charge's amount less every payment and waiver already naming it.

**2. Settled charges.** A charge that has already been paid or waived in full takes no further payment or waiver. This is read from the payments and waivers already recorded against that charge.

**3. Payment methods.** Payment methods are card, ACH, cash and check; insurer direct is accepted only on an insurance-claim booking of an estimate type that allows insurer direct billing.

**4. Waivers.** Waivers have three reasons and do not stack beyond the outstanding amount.

- **Converted to repair.** When the booking converts no later than the conversion credit window days after the estimate written date, every teardown, pre-repair scan, measurement and tow-in charge whose credit flag for the estimate type is set is waived for its outstanding amount on the conversion date; mobile trip and storage charges are never credited.
- **Billing error.** A charge posted at a wrong amount or on the wrong fee type is waived down to the correct amount.
- **Goodwill — retired clause, no longer in force.** "Goodwill: the desk may waive at most the estimate type's goodwill authority per booking across all charges (the goodwill waived on the booking); a request beyond that authority is declined at the desk." This clause is no longer in force and has been superseded by the current storage goodwill basis.

### Worked settlement (hypothetical figures)

| Charge | Amount | Already paid | Outstanding before the entry | Entry | Accepted? |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Scan | 50.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 50.00 USD | Card payment 50.00 USD | Yes |
| Scan | 50.00 USD | 50.00 USD | 0.00 USD | Any further payment or waiver | No — settled in full |
| Teardown | 200.00 USD | 80.00 USD | 120.00 USD | Billing-error waiver 150.00 USD | No — exceeds the outstanding amount |

Hypothetical conversion: a Scheduled Estimate (14-day credit window, scan credited) whose 49.95 USD scan charge is unpaid converts on day 10 after the estimate written date: the scan charge is waived for its outstanding 49.95 USD on the conversion date. The same booking converting on day 20 earns no credit.

superseded_clauses: goodwill: the desk may waive at most goodwill_waiver_authority_usd per booking across all charges (estimate_msr_goodwill_waived); a request beyond that authority is declined at the desk.
